summary: The page covers the assigned migration workflows, uses supported claims and labeled hypothetical examples, and adds no unassigned FAQ. Links match the supplied source records; live availability was not independently checked.

glossary.definition: The point at which the new system becomes the working record.
An inventory class for records needed for planning or follow-up.
An inventory class for records worth keeping and making searchable but not used in daily work.
An inventory class for records kept in their existing location with a pointer from the new system.
An inventory class for records no longer needed, subject to retention rules.

decisions: Classify each record type and accept or return the inventory.
Assign ownership and an interim class when ownership or retention rules are unclear.
Fix, defer or mark data gaps as unknown.
Establish relationship matches or seek approval for unknown links.
Accept or rerun the pilot, or approve progression with a documented gap.
Approve or postpone cutover based on verification, gap limits and access.
Roll back or continue with an approved, limited gap when a cutover trigger is met.
Determine how paper records and late changes will be handled.
